plans.idea: Mirror the original left-to-right: a properly sized logo opens the strip, the headline and subhead get a wide central band so the headline runs large on one line, and the product box closes on the right as in the source.
Product-first: the orange box anchors the left edge as the eye-catcher, the copy reads across the middle, and the logo signs off on the right like a banner end-card.
Message-first: the headline starts flush left at the largest possible size, then product and logo are grouped together on the right as a brand/product lockup that closes the read.
